name: anti-no-overlays
js: (async()=>{await window.atlas.updateSettings({labelsOverlay:false});const rows=[...document.querySelectorAll('label')];const switched=[];for(const name of ['State & country boundaries','Earthquakes']){const row=rows.find(r=>r.textContent.trim()===name);const input=row?.querySelector('input[type=checkbox]');if(input?.checked){input.click();switched.push(name);}}await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,4000));return {switched};})()
